title: spiral-envelope (envelope_version 1)
description: A serialized spiral-envelope. Fields marked "x-visibility": "internal" are resume state whose shape may change without a version bump; read the public ones.

envelope_version.description: The envelope format version (bumped when an envelope written now could not be read by the code that wrote it).

config.description: The resolved world config (seed, regionSize, quotas, pools, …).

compileIn.description: The compile inputs (seed, loop mode, completion item).

completed.description: Index into SPIRAL_STEPS of the last step run; -1 = none.

arrange.description: The spiral arrangement: sequence, cells, startCell, gridDims, items.

rng.description: The rng position after the shuffle and deal.

content.description: The generated content dataset (jta), or null.

regions.description: The built regions: stats, startCell, goalItem (public) and the tagged Grid encoding (grid, internal).
